correctness.rationale: Complete face classification gives a join of two complete-graph one-skeleta, two cones over their joined zero-skeleta, and the common edge. The complete-bipartite linking graph is connected; its inclusion in the simply connected join is nullhomotopic. Two cofibration mapping-cone splittings, the final extra one-cell, and graph-cycle-rank calculations yield the integral wedge in all parameter cases. Reproducible independent mod-two checks passed 25 cases; finite checks are explicitly not substitutes for the integral proof.

value.rationale: The natural smallest edge overlap of two maximal cliques lies immediately outside the motivating diamond-free/block-graph shellability theorem. The classification reveals a stable essential first circle and independently varying two- and three-sphere multiplicities, information not supplied by shellability, face-count or Euler-characteristic results. It treats every pair of clique sizes, including genuine mixed-dimensional examples, with an integral homotopy proof.
